The Weaving Art

How Your Saree is Born

From village looms in Odisha to your hands — a journey of true craftsmanship

01
Thread Selection

Only the finest silk and cotton threads are hand-selected. Every fiber is checked for quality before weaving begins.

02
Bandha Dyeing

Threads are tied and dyed using the ancient Bandha Ikat technique — creating the iconic pattern before weaving even starts.

03
Handloom Weaving

Skilled artisans weave on traditional pit looms. A single silk saree can take 15–45 days to complete by hand.

04
Quality & Delivery

Each saree passes a thorough quality check before careful packaging and dispatch across India and worldwide.

Common Questions

Got a Question?

A Sambalpuri saree is a traditional handloom saree from the Sambalpur and Western Odisha region. It is made using the Bandha (tie-dye Ikat) technique, where threads are tied and dyed before weaving — creating famous patterns like Pasapalli (chess), Phula (flower), Shankha (conch), and elephant/peacock motifs. Sambalpuri sarees hold a GI (Geographical Indication) tag certifying their authentic origin.
You can order in three ways: (1) Visit our store at Manasapola, Jajpur during business hours, (2) WhatsApp us on 9776164994 or 7008662515 — send us your requirements and we'll share photos and prices, (3) Call us directly and we can guide you through our current collection. WhatsApp ordering with photos is the most popular option for customers outside Jajpur.
Yes! We ship across all of India. Orders are typically dispatched within 2–3 business days and delivered in 5–7 business days within India. For international shipping (USA, UK, UAE, Australia, etc.), please contact us directly on WhatsApp for shipping costs and timelines.
Authentic Sambalpuri sarees have identical patterns on both sides of the fabric — a hallmark of true Ikat weaving. The patterns will be slightly irregular because they are hand-woven, and the colours will have a natural depth. Machine-made imitations often show pattern blurring and only have the design on one side. At Sanskrutikaa, every saree is sourced directly from certified artisan weavers.
Silk sarees: dry clean recommended. Cotton sarees: gentle hand wash in cold water with mild detergent — avoid wringing, dry in shade. Do not bleach. Store folded in a muslin cloth in a cool, dry place. Air your saree every few months to preserve the fabric. With proper care, a Sambalpuri saree lasts generations.
Yes, we welcome wholesale and bulk enquiries from retailers, boutiques, and corporates for gifting. Please WhatsApp us on 9776164994 with your requirements and we will share bulk pricing and minimum order details.
